covered_report_window: Wednesday, July 29, 2026 after the U.S. market close plus Thursday, July 30, 2026 before the U.S. market open
market_context_summary: Run occurred while U.S. markets were open. Major context: Fed decision risk, oil/geopolitical shock, AI and semiconductor weakness after SK Hynix, and intense scrutiny of hyperscaler capex after Alphabet's capex-driven selloff.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Mastercard has the cleanest low-disparity upside setup if cross-border and switched-volume trends stay resilient.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists MA before open with EPS/revenue estimates of $4.91 and $9.3B; Mastercard IR lists the Q2 call on July 30 at 9 a.m. ET.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cross-border volume, services, and margin tone exceed a quality-stock bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Travel or consumer-spend softness undermines a premium multiple.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move quote used; large-cap quality positioning suggests moderate reaction risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus remains constructive; cross-border and volume mix matter more than EPS alone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Meta can rally if ad growth and AI monetization narrative absorb capex fears, but reversal risk is high.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists META after close; MarketWatch/IBD previews frame revenue growth near 26.7% and capex guidance as decisive.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong ad growth, user engagement, and disciplined capex language.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Higher 2026/2027 capex or weaker user metrics overwhelms a beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public reports cite roughly a 4% expected move and recent stock weakness.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts remain broadly positive but focused on AI capex payback.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Qualcomm has upside if guidance validates diversification, but the June quarter is less important than the September outlook.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists QCOM after close; Barron's cites expectations around $2.24 EPS on $9.7B revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: China Android stabilization plus data-center/auto AI credibility.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak handset guide or margin pressure cuts off the AI-diversification story.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move quote used; semiconductor macro raises two-way risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The market will care more about the September guide and non-handset targets than reported EPS.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The turnaround is real enough to avoid a bearish call, but the same-day edge depends on comps and traffic clarity.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists SBUX after close with EPS/revenue estimates near $0.67 and $9.3B; Q2 showed revenue up 9% and North America comparable sales up 7.1%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Traffic and comp sales confirm turnaround durability.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Margin investments or China weakness offset sales improvement.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move quote used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus expects recovery; comps and traffic matter more than EPS.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q1 momentum was excellent, but a large run means Q2 likely needs billings and guidance upside to work.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists FTNT after close; Q1 revenue rose 20% and billings rose 31%, while public data show expected Q2 EPS around $0.73-$0.76.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Billings and firewall refresh demand accelerate again.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Anything short of strong billings risks sell-the-news.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Sahm Capital cited a 12.40% implied move and a 93.2% YTD gain.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Billings and guidance quality dominate headline EPS.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Azure can support the stock, but capex and free-cash-flow optics make the directional edge too balanced.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists MSFT after close; MarketWatch cites FactSet expectations of $87.6B revenue and $4.24 EPS, while options reports cite a 6.6% expected move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Azure growth stays strong and capex is framed as disciplined monetization.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Higher capex without Azure acceleration triggers FCF repricing.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Barron's cited a 6.6% expected move and elevated short interest since 2015.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts are focused on Azure growth and capex rather than EPS alone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: BMY has solid Q1 execution, but the event needs pipeline or growth-portfolio clarity to create a clean same-day edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists BMY before open with estimates near $1.60 EPS and $11.9B revenue; Q1 revenue rose 3% and growth portfolio revenue rose 12%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Eliquis and growth portfolio remain above plan.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Legacy decline, patent-risk narrative, or pipeline tone disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move quote used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Guidance tracking upper end supports the floor but does not create a strong edge.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Lam has strong AI-memory exposure, but the YTD run and semiconductor selloff make the near-term reaction highly two-way.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists LRCX after close; public previews cite EPS around $1.69-$1.72 and revenue around $6.65B-$6.8B.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Memory spending and 2027 equipment-budget commentary surprise higher.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: China mix, margin, or budget commentary fails a high bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Sahm Capital cited a 12.62% implied move and an 82.1% YTD gain.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Expectations are elevated; the first 2027 WFE read matters most.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Operational momentum is strong, but valuation and expected retail GPU decline make the same-day setup fragile and squeeze-prone.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists CVNA after close; Q1 retail units rose 40% and revenue 52%, but public previews note concern over Q2 retail GPU comparisons.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Units, GPU, EBITDA, and guidance show durable scale economics.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: GPU or margin normalization punctures valuation support.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: High-volatility growth name with meaningful squeeze risk; no reliable current implied-move quote used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus EPS revisions improved, but the key metric is GPU quality.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 142% YTD gain makes Arm vulnerable unless royalty growth and guidance beat an extremely high AI narrative bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Digrin lists ARM after close with EPS/revenue estimates near $0.41 and $1.3B; Fool notes the stock is up 142% YTD into the report.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI server and custom silicon licensing momentum exceeds whisper expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A normal beat is not enough for the valuation and YTD run.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Momentum positioning appears crowded; no reliable current implied-move quote used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The key metric is royalty/guidance durability, not EPS alone.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Stocks/options trading and prediction-market growth offset crypto weakness.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Crypto slump, expense growth, or weak net deposits disappoint.

research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

consensus_method_note: Disparity is a 0-100 disagreement measure across three independent passes. Low disparity supported MA most clearly. Moderate disparity and higher reversal risk trimmed META, QCOM, MSFT, FTNT, and HOOD. High reversal risk excluded META, HOOD, ARM, CVNA, LRCX, and FTNT from allocation despite interesting directional setups.
disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
